_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. Copy to tests/<env>-suite-config.json and replace all <PLACEHOLDERS>. Never commit a file containing real IDs/ARNs. See SPEC.md sections 8 and 9.

safety._comment: Live-agent and side-effect protections. Keep blockQueueTransfers=true unless you have a deliberate reason. See SPEC.md section 7.

resources._comment: Reusable resource references. Create one always-open and one always-closed hours-of-operation for business-hours/after-hours simulation.

testCases._comment: Example 1 — Voice DTMF path with a mocked Lambda so the real function is never invoked. Ends before any queue transfer.
testCases.name: menu-option-1-<destination>
testCases.description: DTMF 1 routes to <destination> and plays the expected prompt

testCases._comment: Example 2 — After-hours branch via hours-of-operation mock (OutOfHours). Ends on the closed message.
testCases.name: after-hours-closed-message
testCases.description: Validates the closed message plays when outside business hours

testCases._comment: Example 3 — Chat greeting validation. Simple single-message observation.
testCases.name: chat-greeting
testCases.description: Validates the chat contact flow greeting

testCases._comment: Example 4 — Queue-routing validation done SAFELY. Observe the transfer action and end immediately; optionally substitute an agent-free test queue. Never observe events after the contact is enqueued. See SPEC.md section 7.
testCases.name: menu-option-2-queue-routing
testCases.description: DTMF 2 triggers a queue transfer to the expected queue (ends before reaching an agent)
